subject: Operationalizing 'no-model-improve' — evidence pack, SFTP export, and prompt/response IP
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@healtix.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Healtix — evidence & operational asks for no-model-improve commitment

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Quick follow from our security review: to accept a 'no-model-improve' (no-training) commitment we need a short ops/evidence pack that shows how data flows, where tenant prompts/responses are stored (if anywhere), and an export path for historical interactions (SFTP preferred). Specifically our security and legal teams asked for: 
- a canonical evidence manifest (what logs/telemetry are stored, retention periods),
- a confirmed export mechanism for customer data (SFTP endpoint + contract SLA),
- prompt/response IP/ownership language we can include in the DPA addendum.

Can you share an operational checklist and any sample artifacts we can attach to our procurement ticket? We need this by next Friday to keep the pilot schedule (PO pending).

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Security Program Manager, Healtix

---
(This message was also sent to procurement@healtix.com)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@healtix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-05-13T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Healtix — evidence & operational asks for no-model-improve commitment

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. High-level plan below and attaching an initial evidence manifest draft. We'll iterate with your security/legal.

Summary (short):
- Commitment: Redwood will not use Healtix tenant data to improve or retrain models for any hosted inference tied to the HLX account. This will be reflected in the DPA addendum (draft to follow).
- Evidence pack: attached "evidence_manifest_v1.pdf" describing stored telemetry (request metadata, ephemeral KV logs) and retention controls.
- Export path: we support SFTP export of interaction logs (nightly or on-demand), plus an API-based bulk export. SFTP instructions attached as a plain text stub.
- Prompt/response IP: default Redwood policy is that customer inputs and generated outputs remain the customer's content; proposed contractual language is included in the manifest appendix.

Action items for Redwood ops/legal: David, can you confirm the SFTP flow and residency/KMS constraints (we need to confirm onshore handling for Healtix) and whether we can provide an on-demand export that includes redaction stamps?

Liam — once we confirm the technicals, Marissa will share the suggested DPA addendum language and a one-page summary for procurement.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (draft), sftp-instructions.txt (stub)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>, Liam O'Connor <liam@healtix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-05-13T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Healtix — evidence & operational asks for no-model-improve commitment

Thanks — technical confirmation below. I'm pasting the relevant bullets so your security team can slot them into the manifest.

Technical details:
- Data capture: By default we store request/response traces for 30 days for debugging (configurable per-customer). For "no-model-improve" customers we can enable Ephemeral Capture: session-level KV is kept transiently (30 seconds) and is not written to long-term logs.
- Export: We support scheduled SFTP nightly export (incremental) and an on-demand bulk export via secure API. Exports are encrypted in transit (SFTP over SSH) and at rest encrypted under customer-scoped KMS keys (optional for Dedicated/Private customers).
- Onshore routing: We can route exports to an onshore SFTP endpoint or provide a transient staging bucket in the customer's chosen region — confirm the Healtix endpoint and region and we'll pin the export route.
- Proof/evidence: we can provide signed delivery receipts for each export plus server-side audit logs showing the export job run times (these are included in evidence_manifest_v1.pdf).
- Redaction: We have a redaction pipeline that can optionally remove or hash sensitive fields pre-export (field-level selectors). This adds processing time but is available if you want a sanitized export.

Open questions for Healtix:
- Do you require signed receipts to be pushed to a specific ticketing system (e.g., upload to your SFTP and a webhook to procurement)?
- What retention guarantee does legal require for the exported dataset? (We can set export TTL on the staging bucket.)

I can follow up with an ops runbook section if you want a step-by-step.

-David
David Kim
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@healtix.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example>
Bcc: procurement@healtix.com
Date: 2026-05-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Healtix — evidence & operational asks for no-model-improve commitment

Hi Liam — looping procurement and legal on this thread. Attached is the evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (working draft) and the SFTP instructions stub. Next steps from our side: 

1) Redwood to provide a short DPA addendum (no-model-improve) — draft linked here: https://docusign.example/HLX-2026-042/no-train-amendment.
2) Healtix to confirm SFTP hostname + preferred export cadence and whether you want field-level redaction.
3) Once SFTP details are confirmed, Redwood ops will schedule an onboarding export and provide signed delivery receipts for the initial transfer.

Procurement: if you can open a PO referencing deal HLX-2026-042 we can lock the export window and SLA (we propose 48-hour turnaround for ad-hoc on-demand exports).

If the Healtix legal team wants slightly stricter wording on prompt/response ownership we can propose the following: "Customer data and outputs remain Customer-owned; Redwood asserts no rights to use Customer data for model improvement and will not include Customer data in training/evaluation corpora." Let me know if you'd like alternate phrasing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.pdf, sftp-instructions.txt
